headline: Copper Rises 1.65 Percent To $6.62 As Money Enters The Industrial Pipe
narrative: Copper rose 1.65 percent to $6.62, with money moving into the industrial-metals pipe. Gold rose 0.29 percent to $4,050 and silver rose 0.11 percent to $54.17, so the precious-metals pipe was bid with copper, while oil fell 0.42 percent to $101.33 as the energy pipe was offered. The S&P 500 rose 0.12 percent to 7,685.85, a smaller bid in the equity pipe beside the copper move.
author: jordan
